reviewMethod: AI-assisted locale-by-locale translation-quality audit directly against canonical en-AU, covering every existing genuine translated UI/accessibility/status catalogue and Mining Risk Acknowledgement v1.0. The audit separately checked semantic fidelity, omitted or added meaning, natural contemporary usage, repeated terminology, mining-mode consistency, protected technical identifiers, legal/risk qualifications and the GPL distribution-versus-warranty distinction.
certification: The Safex Mine translations are AI-assisted community-project translations, and language/terminology corrections—including native-speaker feedback—remain welcome.
